papers.title: Variational Inference over Non-differentiable Cardiac Simulators using Bayesian Optimization
papers.abstract: Performing inference over simulators is generally intractable as their runtime means we cannot compute a marginal likelihood. We develop a likelihood-free inference method to infer parameters for a cardiac simulator, which replicates electrical flow through the heart to the body surface. We improve the fit of a state-of-the-art simulator to an electrocardiogram (ECG) recorded from a real patient.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该方法使用贝叶斯优化对昂贵心脏模拟器进行参数推断，可迁移至植入物设计中的代理模型优化问题。
llm.why_not_core: This paper does not address FEA for implant design, structural mechanics constraints, or multi-objective optimization; it focuses on parameter inference for a cardiac electrophysiology simulator.

summary_zh.motivation: 解决心脏模拟器参数推断计算昂贵且无法计算边际似然的问题
summary_zh.method: 使用贝叶斯优化的无似然推断方法校准模拟器参数
summary_zh.result: 改善了对真实患者心电图的拟合效果
summary_zh.validation: 通过真实患者心电图数据进行验证

summary_en.motivation: To enable inference over computationally expensive cardiac simulators where marginal likelihood is intractable
summary_en.method: Developed a likelihood-free inference approach using Bayesian optimization to calibrate simulator parameters
summary_en.result: Improved the fit of a state-of-the-art cardiac simulator to a real patient's electrocardiogram
summary_en.validation: Validated by fitting simulator output to clinical ECG recordings from a real patient

papers.title: A hierarchical computational model for moving thermal loads and phase changes with applications to selective laser melting
papers.first_author_affiliation: Chair for Computation in Engineering, Technische Universität München, Arcisstr. 21, 80333 München, Germany

corresponding_authors.name: Stefan Kollmannsberger
corresponding_authors.affiliation: Chair for Computation in Engineering, Technische Universität München, Arcisstr. 21, 80333 München, Germany

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文仅涉及SLM热模拟，未涉及生物医学植入物的多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳测试。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on a thermal simulation model for selective laser melting without any experimental validation, biomedical context, or evaluation of porous structures, stress shielding, or fatigue properties.

summary_zh.motivation: 开发分层计算模型以模拟SLM中的移动热载荷和相变现象
summary_zh.method: 提出带有移动热源的分层热模型
summary_zh.result: 模型能有效预测温度分布和熔池演化
summary_zh.validation: 通过数值模拟与文献数据对比验证

summary_en.motivation: To develop a hierarchical computational model that captures moving thermal loads and phase changes during selective laser melting.
summary_en.method: A hierarchical thermal model incorporating moving heat sources and phase change dynamics was formulated.
summary_en.result: The model accurately predicted temperature distributions and melt pool evolution.
summary_en.validation: Validation was performed through numerical simulation and comparison with literature data.
